assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Trapezoid ABCD with AB on top, drawn to scale, the dashed midline through W and X, the angle bisectors from A, B, C and D meeting at W, X, Y and Z, and triangles ABZ and CYD lightly shaded.

difficulty_rationale: Seeing that W and X lie on the midline and expressing all areas through AB h, DC h and the cotangents of the half-angles takes several connected insights; the sign choice WX > 0 picks the root.
